SourceString: Pulse Rifle
Fires fast bolts at the nearest enemy.
Scatter Cannon
Blasts a cone of pellets at close range.
Orbital Drones
Drones circle you and fire at whatever comes near.
Rail Lance
A slow, <kw id="Pierce">piercing</kw> lance down the densest line.
Flak Mortar
Lobs shells onto the thickest crowd; they burst on landing.
Arc Blade
Sweeps a wide blade around you at whatever is closest.
Seeker Swarm
Launches micro-missiles that hunt down random enemies.
Ring Emitter
Pulses a ring of bullets in every direction.
Spiral Projector
Spins out an endless spiral of bullets.
Gravity Mine
Drops a mine on a crowd: it pulls them in, then detonates.
